question: NOAA sums °C × weeks above summer peak, skipping any under 1 °C. How many °C-weeks: 8 weeks at +0.9, then 4 at +1.5?
move: A threshold can turn a long mild stretch into zero; apply it first.
trap: Counting all twelve weeks and getting 13.2.
hint: Check which weeks clear the threshold before multiplying anything.
steps: The 8 weeks at +0.9 °C fall below the 1 °C cut-off, so they add nothing.
The 4 weeks at +1.5 °C count in full: 4 × 1.5.
reference: Liu et al., Reef-scale thermal stress monitoring of coral ecosystems: new 5-km global products from NOAA Coral Reef Watch, Remote Sensing, 2014
